changelog: Three things in one release (the originally-planned v34/v35 were merged before the first push, so every device jumps straight here from v33): (1) Adds a 'Responses' card (native HA Button cards) to the Comfort Entities dashboard for the bridge addon's button.comfort_* response entities, one-time per device. Background: v33 rightly stopped updates from overwriting storage dashboards, but that also meant devices whose addon discovers response buttons after their dashboard was applied got no UI for them at all. first_boot.sh gains ensure_responses_card(), which only ever ADDS the card (never replaces a whole dashcard or touches user cards), converts a legacy non-native button include to the native button card if one exists, and is idempotent thereafter. A native Button card is used deliberately: the earlier custom card used button-card v5's tap_action call-service path with an action-level 'entity:' which button-card silently drops, so the click failed with a missing-entity_id error -- the native card has press built in with no tap_action at all. The ensure is gated on at least one button.comfort_* entity existing (queried via the Supervisor states API), so on a device that updates its app after this config update, the card is added on the next core restart once discovery has created the buttons -- updating the app first and the config second is the ideal order, but there is no user config work in any order. The write keeps a .pre_v34_backup copy of the dashboard. zones_dashboard.json (reference/golden-image seed) gets the same button-only Responses card. (2) Adds a 'System Status' card to the Comfort Alarm dashboard (dashboards/alarm.yaml) plus the mqtt sensor that feeds it (packages/cytech.yaml -> sensor.comfort_system_status, reads cytech_comfort_mqtt/alarm with availability on cytech_comfort_mqtt/alarm/online). Background: HA's alarm_control_panel maps Idle/Trouble/Alert all to 'disarmed', so a panel sitting in TROUBLE was completely invisible in HA -- the Alarm Status card showed 'System Disarmed' while the panel displayed Trouble. This makes the raw status word visible: a compact row under the arming buttons shows Status: Trouble/Alarm (red), Alert (orange) or Normal, with a small icon-only Refresh button on its right that presses button.cytech_comfort_mqtt_refresh (the panel refresh-key entity the bridge republishes from the SN01 serial report) to force a fresh panel read. (3) Fixes the stuck 'triggered' alarm: the bridge publishes the raw status word (Idle/Trouble/Alert/Alarm) on cytech_comfort_mqtt/alarm and its AM report handler additionally publishes a literal 'triggered' for zone-trouble codes, which the panel latches with nothing ever clearing it -- HA accepts only disarmed/armed_*/triggered on an MQTT alarm panel and rejects every other payload. ensure_comfort_alarm_template() in first_boot.sh surgically adds the value_template (Alarm -> triggered, Idle/Trouble/Alert -> disarmed, else passthrough) to the panel's mqtt.alarm_control_panel entry in /config/configuration.yaml (backup .pre_v34_backup, HA restart only when changed) -- the same template live-tested on the test device 2026-09-03 where the panel sat stuck triggered. The addon-side AM change (stop publishing literal 'triggered') is tracked separately in the ucmpi4 addon and is NOT delivered by this version. Developed and live-tested on the test device 2026-09-02/03 (zone 1/2 trouble reproduced, card + sensor verified end-to-end, stuck-triggered confirmed fixed, YAML validated, backups kept: /config/dashboards/alarm.yaml.bak_pre_systemstatus_20260903 and /config/configuration.yaml.pre_v34_backup).
